Europe's electric car sales jump 49% as global EV sales grow

Global EV sales climbed 8% in October, with Europe’s battery electric vehicle (BEV) sales jumping 49% and North America posting its first year-over-year increase in 2026. But that North American rebound comes with a big catch. Drivers bought 2.09 million EVs worldwide last month, according to new data from Benchmark Mineral Intelligence .
